items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Blanche Thomas was vocal with my group.

ctx.x: And did George ever work in your band? No, George never worked in my band. Not regular. No.

Did you ever know Blanche Thomas? Blanche Thomas was vocal with my group. Where? At Leroy Place. During the time I was just telling this now about Frog and Jack and them working with me. But Blanche was working during the time with us. Yeah, she was vocal during the time.
Was there a place called the Playhouse or the Playboy or something like that around?
